sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Blinds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 110. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies psychological contamination for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases your water elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Sea Goat Symbiotic Pair] Mary & Puko or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
